links.outcome: Gap between exam-based scores and performance on real-world medical queries
links.effect: Baseline evaluations reveal significant performance disparities among state-of-the-art models on real-world clinical nuances; no numeric gap is reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Crucially, baseline evaluations on this benchmark reveal significant performance disparities among state-of-the-art models when navigating real-world clinical nuances, highlighting the limitations of conventional exam-based metrics.

unlisted_practices: Automated rubric generation using multi-model consensus and evidence-based retrieval, validated against clinical expert blind audits (91.8% concordance)
Hierarchical weighting with safety constraints for scoring open-ended medical answers

screen.reason: The paper presents a medical LLM benchmark (QuarkMedBench) using automated scoring rubrics for real-world medical queries, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
